decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Unnumbered Location Plan, 41FR.01, Existing and Proposed First Floor, Existing and Proposed Second Floor, 41FR.04, 41FR.05, 41FR.06, 41FR.07, 41FR.08, Planning Statement, Tree Survey, Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Arboricultural Method Statement & Tree Protection Plan, Construction Method Statement, Fire Safety Strategy and Flood Risk Assessment. Received: 03/09/2025].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 4 - The development shall take place according to the approved Construction Method Statement.
Reason: In order to protect the living conditions of neighbouring residents, to minimise flood risk and to ensure highway safety is maintained.

Condition : 5 - The development shall take place according to the approved Tree Survey, Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Arboricultural Method Statement & Tree Protection Plan.
Reason: In order to protect the trees and the appearance of the property and the area.
description: Enlargement of existing basement to the house.
